tex_content.html:
Any Ricci flow with surgery satisfying Assumptions (1)--(7) of Chapter sect:surgery has only finitely many homotopically essential sphere surgeries.
Proof

↗ surgerytoptype \sketch By Lemma 2.1, $s(M_0)$ is finite. Claim 2.1 makes $s(t)$ a nonnegative integer that drops at every essential surgery.

□

dependencies.description:
\label{surgerytoptype}
Suppose $({\mathcal M},G)$ satisfies Assumptions (1)--(7), and let $t$ be a
singular time. For $t^-<t$ sufficiently close, $M_{t^-}$ is obtained from the
disjoint union of $M_t$, finitely many $2$-sphere bundles over $S^1$, and finitely
many closed $3$-manifolds of constant positive curvature by connected-sum
operations among components.
\end{proposition}
